blocks.content: I have been contacted by a few people who have been following the blog and asked if it will continue, and when. The answer to this is: yes, and I don’t know for sure. Due to other academic commitments (check out my new book, if the seventeenth-century colonisation of Ulster and North America interests you) I have to curtail my activities here, as much as I have enjoyed writing this. I do intend taking it up again at some future date in the next year or so hopefully. Many thanks to those of you who have shown an interest!
